title: Quick look: lesion network overlap (Boes 2015)
differences_from_source: Per-lesion maps are thresholded with the N-aware Bonferroni FWE rule (alpha 0.05, re-derived for the connectome's N); the source thresholded each map at a fixed |T| (4.25, voxelwise p < 0.00005 uncorrected) on a 98-subject connectome.
The connectome is the one chosen in Map (for example GSP1000), not the source's.
Connectome QA chips (similarity to connectome degree and PC1) are shown next to the overlap; the source had no such check.
No specificity test and no null model: the overlap map is descriptive and is not evidence of specificity.
description: Classic overlap of thresholded lesion network maps (count and percent of lesions, at the overlap level) for a first look at a cohort. Descriptive only.
